entities.summary: Carla Dupuy is an Argentine field hockey player. At the 2009 Champions Trophy she competed for Argentina winning the gold medal in her first senior international tournament. She was chosen as an alternate player for the 2012 Summer Olympics. After a brief participation with the national team in 2013, she returned in late 2015 and won the 2014–2015 World League.
